mapper.select: SELECT a.USER_NM ,a.LANG_CD ,a.STATE_CD ,a.ROLE_CD ,a.BIRTH_DT ,a.GENDER_CD ,a.PHONE_NUM FROM tb_trma_user_info a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT a.CMM_CDV ,a.CMM_CM_NM FROM tb_trma_cmm_cd_d a WHERE a.CMM_CD_ID = #{cmmCdId}

SELECT b.TOUR_ID ,b.TOUR_NM ,b.SIDO_CD ,c1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM ,b.SGG_CD ,c2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM ,b.EMD_CD ,c3.CMM_CM_NM AS END_NM ,b.ROAD_ADDR ,b.DETAIL_ADDR ,b.ZIP_CD ,AVG(a.REVIEW_SCORE) AS AVG_SCORE FROM tb_trma_moim_review a LEFT JOIN tb_trma_tour_list b ON a.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN tb_trma_cmm_cd_d c1 ON b.SIDO_CD = c1.CMM_CDV AND c1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' LEFT JOIN tb_trma_cmm_cd_d c2 ON b.SIDO_CD = c1.CMM_CDV AND c2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' LEFT JOIN tb_trma_cmm_cd_d c3 ON b.SIDO_CD = c1.CMM_CDV AND c3.CMM_CD_ID = 'EMD_CD' WHERE b.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY b.TOUR_ID ,b.TOUR_NM ,b.SIDO_CD ,c1.CMM_CM_NM ,b.SGG_CD ,c2.CMM_CM_NM ,b.EMD_CD ,c3.CMM_CM_NM ,b.ROAD_ADDR ,b.DETAIL_ADDR ,b.ZIP_CD ORDER BY AVG_SCORE DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT b.MOIM_ID ,b.MOIM_TITLE ,b.MOIM_DSCR ,b.MOIM_CATE_CD ,c.CMM_CM_NM AS MOIM_CATE_NM ,b.MOIM_START_DT ,b.MOIM_END_DT ,b.CREATE_DT AS USER_ID ,d.USER_NM ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_trma_moim_member mm WHERE mm.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID AND mm.ROLE_CD = 'A') AS MEMBER_CNT ,COUNT(*) AS VISIT_CNT FROM tb_trma_moim_visit_h a LEFT JOIN tb_trma_moim_list b ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN tb_trma_cmm_cd_d c ON b.MOIM_CATE_CD = c.CMM_CDV AND c.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' LEFT JOIN tb_trma_user_info d ON b.CREATE_USER = d.USER_ID WHERE b.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY a.MOIM_ID ORDER BY VISIT_CNT DESC LIMIT 10;
